description: Product claims of Identity's /userinfo besides sub (Learning reads them from the answer that authorizes a request; it reads no Identity table). Booleans, computed on every request. mnema_public_profile is listed in contracts/decks/publication.json. The two claims below are internal anti-abuse signals of the community ranking: they are never shown to anybody and carry no personal data.

trusted.rule: (the account's e-mail is verified (email_verified) OR the account has any federated identity (Google, Yandex, GitHub sign-in: the provider confirmed the address, or in the case of Yandex does not vouch for it but the sign-in still counts)) AND the account was created at least minAgeHours ago
trusted.learningUse: a copy by an account that is not trusted weighs 0.25 in the rank; a claim that is ABSENT (an Identity that predates it) is stored as unknown (NULL) and weighs 0.25 until a later copy by the same account fills it; a malformed claim is false

newAccount.rule: the account was created less than maxAgeHours ago
newAccount.learningUse: a copy by a new account counts toward the anomaly flag of the owner console (catalog.json constants.anomaly); an absent claim is stored as unknown (NULL) and a malformed one is false; neither ever raises a flag
